package consumer_test

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"example.invalid/pricing-proof/converted"
)

// This task is explicitly synthetic. It does not add a pricing product to an app.
func TestDeliveredPricingConsumer(t *testing.T) {
	body, err := os.ReadFile("converted/defaults.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("delivered defaults missing")
	}
	var data converted.Pricing
	if json.Unmarshal(body, &data) != nil || data.URL != "" {
		t.Fatal("delivery defaults invalid")
	}
	if _, err := converted.NewPricing(data); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("app-owned destination was not required")
	}
	data.URL = "/pricing/access"
	faithful, err := converted.NewPricing(data)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("faithful constructor failed")
	}
	enhanced, err := converted.NewPricingEnhanced(data)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("enhanced constructor failed")
	}
	for name, component := range map[string]interface {
		Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
	}{
		"baseline.html": faithful, "enhanced.html": enhanced,
	} {
		var out bytes.Buffer
		if err := component.Render(context.Background(), &out); err != nil {
			t.Fatal("render failed")
		}
		if !bytes.Contains(out.Bytes(), []byte(`href="/pricing/access"`)) {
			t.Fatal("native destination missing")
		}
		f, err := os.OpenFile(name, os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0600)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal("output must be absent")
		}
		_, writeErr := f.Write(out.Bytes())
		closeErr := f.Close()
		if writeErr != nil || closeErr != nil {
			t.Fatal("output failed")
		}
	}
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /pricing", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		// Validate/render before the response begins; no partially written error.
		var body bytes.Buffer
		if err := enhanced.Render(r.Context(), &body); err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "render failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
		_, _ = w.Write(body.Bytes())
	})
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /pricing/access", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
		_, _ = io.WriteString(w, "Synthetic destination only. No purchase or provider call.")
	})
	for _, check := range []struct {
		method, path string
		status       int
	}{
		{"GET", "/pricing", 200}, {"GET", "/pricing/access", 200},
		{"POST", "/pricing", 405}, {"GET", "/missing", 404},
	} {
		response := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(response, httptest.NewRequest(check.method, check.path, nil))
		if response.Code != check.status {
			t.Fatal("synthetic handler returned wrong status")
		}
		if check.path == "/pricing" && check.method == "GET" &&
			(!strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), `data-appkit-pricing`) ||
				!strings.HasPrefix(response.Header().Get("Content-Type"), "text/html")) {
			t.Fatal("enhanced component not actually served")
		}
	}
}
